```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion(component_id, qty) AS (
    SELECT b.component_id, b.per_assembly_qty
    FROM product p
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'BK-T79U-54'
      AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT b.component_id, be.qty * b.per_assembly_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN product comp ON comp.product_id = be.component_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = be.component_id
    WHERE comp.make_flag = TRUE
      AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(be.qty), 0)
FROM bom_explosion be
JOIN product p ON p.product_id = be.component_id
WHERE p.product_number = 'BE-2908';
```

WITH RECURSIVE order_products AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date, sol.product_id, sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id

    WHERE st.name = 'Central'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
),
target AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'MS-1981'
),
demand AS (
    -- direct sales of the part itself
    SELECT op.order_qty AS qty
    FROM order_products op
    JOIN target t ON op.product_id = t.product_id

    UNION ALL

    -- components contained in sold products, BOM valid on order date
    SELECT op.order_qty * b.per_assembly_qty
    FROM order_products op
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = op.product_id
    WHERE b.start_date <= op.order_date
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= op.order_date)
)
SELECT SUM(qty) FROM demand;

        b.per_assembly_qty AS qty,

    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = q.root_id
    WHERE b.start_date <= q.d AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= q.d)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        b.component_id,
        t.qty * b.per_assembly_qty,
        t.d
    FROM tree t
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = t.component_id
    WHERE b.start_date <= t.d AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= t.d)
),
earlier AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.qty), 0) AS q
    FROM tree t
    JOIN qty_on q ON t.d = q.d
    WHERE t.component_id = q.target_id
),
-- current BOM
tree_cur AS (
    SELECT
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS qty
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    WHERE b.assembly_id = (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'BK-R89B-44')
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        b.component_id,
        t.qty * b.per_assembly_qty
    FROM tree_cur t
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = t.component_id
    WHERE b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
),
current_q AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS q
    FROM tree_cur
    WHERE component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'MS-0253')
)
SELECT (SELECT q FROM current_q) - (SELECT q FROM earlier) AS change;

    FROM bill_of_materials b

),
order_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.order_id,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        CASE WHEN sol.product_id = tp.product_id THEN sol.order_qty ELSE 0 END AS direct_qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    CROSS JOIN target_product tp
    JOIN sales_order so ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON st.territory_id = so.territory_id

    JOIN target_product tp ON bt.component_id = tp.product_id
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(direct_qty), 0) FROM order_demand) +
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(component_qty), 0) FROM component_demand) AS total_demand;

WITH RECURSIVE order_products AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, sol.product_id, sol.order_qty, so.order_date
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northwest'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
demand AS (
    -- direct units sold
    SELECT op.product_id AS component_id, op.order_qty AS qty
    FROM order_products op
    UNION ALL
    -- contained components at any level, BOM valid on order date
    SELECT b.component_id, d.qty * b.per_assembly_qty
    FROM demand d
    JOIN order_products op ON op.product_id = d.component_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = d.component_id
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= op.order_date
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= op.order_date)
)

FROM demand d
JOIN product p ON p.product_id = d.component_id
WHERE p.product_number = 'FK-9939';

WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.order_date,
        sol.product_id AS root_product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty AS path_qty
    FROM sales_order o
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON sol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON st.territory_id = o.territory_id
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = (SELECT product_number FROM product WHERE product_id = sol.product_id)
    WHERE st.name = 'Central'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND c.valid_from <= o.order_date
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= o.order_date)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.order_id,
        b.order_date,
        b.root_product_id,
        b.order_qty,
        c.child_code,
        b.path_qty * c.qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = b.child_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= b.order_date
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= b.order_date)
),
direct AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(sol.order_qty) AS qty
    FROM sales_order o
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON sol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = sol.product_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON st.territory_id = o.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Central'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND p.product_number = 'MS-1981'
),
contained AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(b.path_qty * b.order_qty) AS qty
    FROM bom b
    WHERE b.child_code = 'MS-1981'
)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT qty FROM direct), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT qty FROM contained), 0) AS total_demand;

),

    SELECT 
        bt.parent_code AS bike_code,
        bt.child_code AS component_code,
        SUM(bt.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM bom_tree bt
    GROUP BY bt.parent_code, bt.child_code
),
order_component_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty AS direct_qty,
        bc.component_code,
        bc.total_qty * sol.order_qty AS component_qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN bike_components bc ON p.product_number = bc.bike_code
    WHERE st.name = 'Northwest'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM so.order_date) = 2024
)
SELECT 
    p.product_number,

WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.order_date,
        sol.order_qty,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty AS path_qty
    FROM sales_order o
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON sol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = sol.product_id
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_code = p.product_number
     AND c.valid_from <= o.order_date
     AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= o.order_date)
    JOIN sales_territory st ON st.territory_id = o.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Australia'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.order_id,
        b.order_date,
        b.order_qty,
        c.child_code,
        b.path_qty * c.qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_code = b.child_code
     AND c.valid_from <= b.order_date
     AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= b.order_date)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(sol.order_qty)
        FROM sales_order o
        JOIN sales_order_line sol ON sol.order_id = o.order_id
        JOIN product p ON p.product_id = sol.product_id
        JOIN sales_territory st ON st.territory_id = o.territory_id
        WHERE st.name = 'Australia'
          AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
          AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
          AND p.product_number = 'PA-632U'
    ), 0)
    +
    COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(b.order_qty * b.path_qty)
        FROM bom b
        WHERE b.child_code = 'PA-632U'
    ), 0) AS total_demand;

    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = sol.product_id

        co.order_date,

    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON sol.order_id = co.order_id
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = sol.product_id
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_code = p.product_number
     AND c.valid_from <= co.order_date
     AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= co.order_date)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.order_id,
        b.order_date,
        b.order_qty,
        c.child_code,
        b.path_qty * c.qty

    -- Start from the target component and walk upward to assemblies

        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id

    WHERE bom.component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'MB-2024')
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'

    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN bom_tree bt ON bom.component_id = bt.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bt.assembly_id) AS bike_count
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN road_bikes rb ON bt.assembly_id = rb.product_id;

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, get all orders from Canada territory in 2025 with their order lines
canada_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Canada'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
),
-- For each product sold, explode its BOM to find all components and their quantities
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct components of products sold
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date,
        co.product_id AS root_product_id,
        co.order_qty,
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS component_qty_per_unit,
        b.bom_level
    FROM canada_orders co
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = co.product_id
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= co.order_date
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= co.order_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components of sub-assemblies (make_flag = true)
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.root_product_id,
        be.order_qty,
        b.component_id,
        be.component_qty_per_unit * b.per_assembly_qty AS component_qty_per_unit,
        b.bom_level
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN product p ON be.component_id = p.product_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = be.component_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = TRUE
      AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= be.order_date)
),
-- Calculate total demand: direct sales of TT-M928 + contained in BOMs
tt_m928_product AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'TT-M928'
),
direct_demand AS (
    -- Units sold directly as TT-M928
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(co.order_qty), 0) AS direct_qty
    FROM canada_orders co
    JOIN tt_m928_product t ON co.product_id = t.product_id
),
bom_demand AS (
    -- Units of TT-M928 contained in other products' BOMs
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(be.order_qty * be.component_qty_per_unit), 0) AS bom_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN tt_m928_product t ON be.component_id = t.product_id
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT direct_qty FROM direct_demand) + 
    (SELECT bom_qty FROM bom_demand) AS total_demand;

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Get the target part
target_part AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'MS-2348'
),
-- Get Central territory
central_territory AS (
    SELECT territory_id FROM sales_territory WHERE name = 'Central'
),
-- Orders from Central territory in 2025
central_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN central_territory ct ON so.territory_id = ct.territory_id
    WHERE so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
),
-- Recursive BOM expansion: for each sold product, find all components at any level
bom_expansion AS (
    -- Base: start from products sold in orders, find their direct components
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date,
        co.product_id AS root_product_id,
        co.order_qty,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS qty_per_unit
    FROM central_orders co
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = co.product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= co.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= co.order_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand sub-assemblies that are manufactured in-house
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.root_product_id,
        be.order_qty,
        bom.component_id,
        be.qty_per_unit * bom.per_assembly_qty AS qty_per_unit
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = be.component_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = be.component_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = TRUE
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= be.order_date)
)
-- Sum demand: direct sales where MS-2348 is sold directly + component demand from BOM expansion
SELECT 
    COALESCE(direct_direct.demand, 0) + COALESCE(bom_demand.demand, 0) AS total_demand
FROM 
    -- Direct sales of MS-2348
    (SELECT SUM(co.order_qty) AS demand
     FROM central_orders co
     JOIN target_part tp ON co.product_id = tp.product_id) AS direct_direct
CROSS JOIN
    -- Component demand from BOM expansion
    (SELECT SUM(be.order_qty * be.qty_per_unit) AS demand
     FROM bom_expansion be
     JOIN target_part tp ON be.component_id = tp.product_id) AS bom_demand;

    FROM bom_explosion be

WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.order_date,
        sol.product_id AS root_product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty AS qty_per_unit
    FROM sales_order o
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON sol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_code = (SELECT product_number FROM product WHERE product_id = sol.product_id)
     AND c.valid_from <= o.order_date
     AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= o.order_date)
    WHERE o.territory_id IN (SELECT territory_id FROM sales_territory WHERE name = 'United Kingdom')
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.order_id,
        b.order_date,
        b.root_product_id,
        b.order_qty,
        c.child_code,
        b.qty_per_unit * c.qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_code = b.child_code
     AND c.valid_from <= b.order_date
     AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= b.order_date)
),
direct AS (
    SELECT SUM(sol.order_qty) AS qty
    FROM sales_order o
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON sol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = sol.product_id
    WHERE o.territory_id IN (SELECT territory_id FROM sales_territory WHERE name = 'United Kingdom')
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND p.product_number = 'HB-T721'
),
contained AS (
    SELECT SUM(b.order_qty * b.qty_per_unit) AS qty
    FROM bom b
    WHERE b.child_code = 'HB-T721'
)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT qty FROM direct), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT qty FROM contained), 0) AS total_demand;

WITH bike_products AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, p.product_number
    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory sc ON p.subcategory_id = sc.subcategory_id
    JOIN product_category c ON sc.category_id = c.category_id
    WHERE c.name = 'Bikes'
),
northwest_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northwest'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT bp.product_number
FROM sales_order_line sol
JOIN northwest_orders no ON sol.order_id = no.order_id
JOIN bike_products bp ON sol.product_id = bp.product_id
GROUP BY bp.product_id, bp.product_number
ORDER BY SUM(sol.order_qty) DESC
LIMIT 3;

    WHERE name = 'Canada'
),

    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id

      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2022-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= DATE '2022-12-31'
    GROUP BY p.product_number
)

FROM bike_sales
ORDER BY total_units DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH RECURSIVE bom_paths AS (
    -- Start from products that have order lines in Northwest 2022
    SELECT 
        sol.order_id,
        sol.line_id,
        sol.product_id AS assembly_id,
        sol.product_id AS component_id,
        sol.order_qty AS total_qty,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS per_unit_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northwest'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2022-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < DATE '2023-01-01'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Walk down the BOM: assembly -> component
    SELECT 
        bp.order_id,
        bp.line_id,
        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        bp.total_qty,
        bp.per_unit_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS per_unit_qty,
        bp.order_date

)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bp.total_qty * bp.per_unit_qty), 0) AS total_demand

JOIN product p ON bp.component_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_number = 'NI-4127';

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Get all orders from Canada territory in 2022
canada_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date, sol.product_id, sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Canada'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2022-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < DATE '2023-01-01'
),
-- For each product sold, explode its BOM recursively to find all components
-- We need to walk from assembly down to components, multiplying quantities
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base: start from products directly ordered (treat as "assembly" with qty = order_qty)
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date,
        co.product_id AS assembly_id,
        co.product_id AS component_id,
        CAST(co.order_qty AS DOUBLE) AS total_qty
    FROM canada_orders co
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand each assembly to its components
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        be.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = be.component_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= be.order_date)
),
-- Get the part we care about
target_part AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'MB-6061'
)
-- Sum demand: direct sales of MB-6061 + component usage in other products
SELECT 
    COALESCE(
        (SELECT SUM(sol.order_qty) 
         FROM canada_orders co2
         JOIN sales_order_line sol ON co2.order_id = sol.order_id AND co2.product_id = sol.product_id
         WHERE co2.product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_part)),
        0
    ) 
    + 
    COALESCE(
        (SELECT SUM(be.total_qty) 
         FROM bom_explosion be
         WHERE be.component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_part)
           AND be.assembly_id != be.component_id),  -- exclude self-references (direct sales already counted)
        0
    ) AS total_demand;

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Find all orders from Canada territory in 2023
canada_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Canada'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
),
-- For each product sold, find all paths to component PD-R853 with quantities
bom_paths AS (
    -- Base case: direct containment (level 1 and deeper, but we start from the sold product)
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date,
        co.product_id AS top_product_id,
        co.order_qty,
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS path_qty,
        b.bom_level
    FROM canada_orders co
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = co.product_id
    WHERE b.start_date <= co.order_date
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= co.order_date)
      AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: walk down to find PD-R853
    SELECT 
        bp.order_id,
        bp.order_date,
        bp.top_product_id,
        bp.order_qty,
        b.component_id,
        bp.path_qty * b.per_assembly_qty AS path_qty,
        b.bom_level
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = bp.component_id
    WHERE b.start_date <= bp.order_date
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= bp.order_date)
      AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
),
-- Find PD-R853 product_id
target_part AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'PD-R853'
),
-- Calculate demand: direct sales + component usage
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sol.order_qty), 0) AS direct_qty
    FROM canada_orders co
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON co.order_id = sol.order_id AND co.product_id = sol.product_id
    JOIN target_part tp ON sol.product_id = tp.product_id
),
component_demand AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bp.order_qty * bp.path_qty), 0) AS component_qty
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN target_part tp ON bp.component_id = tp.product_id
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT direct_qty FROM direct_sales) + 
    (SELECT component_qty FROM component_demand) AS total_demand;

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find the product_id for part MS-2341
target_part AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'MS-2341'
),
-- Canada territory
canada_territory AS (
    SELECT territory_id FROM sales_territory WHERE name = 'Canada'
),
-- Orders from Canada in 2025
canada_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN canada_territory ct ON so.territory_id = ct.territory_id
    WHERE so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
-- Order lines with their products and quantities
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.order_id,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        co.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN canada_orders co ON sol.order_id = co.order_id
),
-- Recursive BOM expansion: for each product sold, find all components at any level
-- with quantities multiplied along the path, using BOM valid on order date
bom_demand AS (
    -- Base case: the product itself (treated as 0 level, we'll add direct sales separately)
    -- Actually we need: for each order line, the product sold and all its components
    -- Start from BOM lines where the assembly is the sold product
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.product_id AS assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty * ol.order_qty AS total_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        1 AS level
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = ol.product_id
    WHERE b.start_date <= ol.order_date
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= ol.order_date)
      AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand components that are themselves assemblies
    SELECT 
        bd.order_id,
        b.assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        bd.total_qty * b.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        bd.order_date,
        bd.level + 1
    FROM bom_demand bd
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = bd.component_id
    WHERE b.start_date <= bd.order_date
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= bd.order_date)
      AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product p WHERE p.product_id = bd.component_id AND p.make_flag = TRUE)
),
-- All demand for MS-2341: from BOM expansions
bom_component_demand AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bd.total_qty), 0) AS bom_demand
    FROM bom_demand bd
    JOIN target_part tp ON bd.component_id = tp.product_id
),
-- Direct sales of MS-2341 (sold as finished product)
direct_sales_demand AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol.order_qty), 0) AS direct_demand
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN target_part tp ON ol.product_id = tp.product_id
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT bom_demand FROM bom_component_demand) + 
    (SELECT direct_demand FROM direct_sales_demand) AS total_demand;
```

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Get all orders for Canada territory in 2022
canada_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date, sol.product_id, sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Canada'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2022-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < DATE '2023-01-01'
),
-- For each product sold, explode its BOM to find all components, with quantities multiplied along the path
bom_exploded AS (
    -- Base: direct components of products sold
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date,
        co.product_id AS top_level_product_id,
        co.order_qty,
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS component_qty_per_unit
    FROM canada_orders co
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = co.product_id
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= co.order_date
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= co.order_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: components of sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.top_level_product_id,
        be.order_qty,
        b.component_id,
        be.component_qty_per_unit * b.per_assembly_qty AS component_qty_per_unit
    FROM bom_exploded be
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = be.component_id
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= be.order_date)
),
-- Combine direct sales (product itself if it's CR-7833) with BOM-derived demand
all_demand AS (
    -- Direct sales of CR-7833
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_qty AS total_component_qty
    FROM canada_orders co
    JOIN product p ON co.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'CR-7833'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Component demand from BOM explosion
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_qty * be.component_qty_per_unit AS total_component_qty
    FROM bom_exploded be
    JOIN product p ON be.component_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'CR-7833'
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_component_qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM all_demand;
```

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Get the target part
target_part AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'TT-R982'
),
-- Get UK territory
uk_territory AS (
    SELECT territory_id FROM sales_territory WHERE name = 'United Kingdom'
),
-- Get 2024 orders from UK territory
uk_orders_2024 AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN uk_territory ut ON so.territory_id = ut.territory_id
    WHERE so.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
-- Get order lines with quantities
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.order_id,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        o.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN uk_orders_2024 o ON sol.order_id = o.order_id
),
-- Recursive BOM expansion: for each product sold, find all paths to TT-R982
-- Start with products that directly contain TT-R982
bom_paths AS (
    -- Direct components of sold products that are TT-R982
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.product_id AS top_product_id,
        ol.order_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS qty_at_level,
        b.per_assembly_qty * ol.order_qty AS total_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = ol.product_id
    WHERE b.component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_part)
      AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= ol.order_date
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= ol.order_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: components that contain TT-R982 at deeper levels
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.product_id AS top_product_id,
        ol.order_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS qty_at_level,
        bp.total_qty * b.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON bp.top_product_id = ol.product_id AND bp.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = bp.component_id
    WHERE b.component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_part)
      AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= ol.order_date
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= ol.order_date)
),
-- Also need to handle the case where TT-R982 is sold directly
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.product_id AS top_product_id,
        ol.order_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.product_id AS component_id,
        1.0 AS qty_at_level,
        ol.order_qty * 1.0 AS total_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    WHERE ol.product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_part)
),
-- Combine all demand sources
all_demand AS (
    SELECT total_qty FROM bom_paths
    UNION ALL
    SELECT total_qty FROM direct_sales
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM all_demand;

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, get all orders from Northeast territory in 2023
northeast_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date, sol.product_id, sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northeast'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= DATE '2023-12-31'
),
-- Get the product_id for FR-R92R-62
target_product AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'FR-R92R-62'
),
-- Recursive CTE to find all BOM paths: for each product sold, find all components at any level
-- We need to trace downward from each product sold to find where FR-R92R-62 appears
bom_expansion AS (
    -- Base case: products sold directly (these are the starting points)
    SELECT 
        no.order_id,
        no.order_date,
        no.product_id AS root_product_id,
        no.product_id AS current_product_id,
        no.order_qty AS qty_at_root,
        CAST(no.order_qty AS DOUBLE) AS total_qty,
        0 AS bom_level
    FROM northeast_orders no
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand components
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.root_product_id,
        bom.component_id AS current_product_id,
        be.qty_at_root,
        be.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        be.bom_level + 1
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = be.current_product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= be.order_date)
),
-- Get direct sales of FR-R92R-62
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(no.order_qty) AS direct_qty
    FROM northeast_orders no
    JOIN target_product tp ON no.product_id = tp.product_id
),
-- Get component demand (where FR-R92R-62 appears as a component in BOM)
component_demand AS (
    SELECT SUM(be.total_qty) AS component_qty
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN target_product tp ON be.current_product_id = tp.product_id
    WHERE be.bom_level > 0  -- exclude level 0 (direct sales already counted separately, though this shouldn't match anyway since we're looking for component appearances)
)
SELECT COALESCE(ds.direct_qty, 0) + COALESCE(cd.component_qty, 0) AS total_demand
FROM direct_sales ds
CROSS JOIN component_demand cd;

    SELECT territory_id FROM sales_territory WHERE name = 'Central'

-- Orders in Central territory in 2025

        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN central_territory ct ON so.territory_id = ct.territory_id
    WHERE so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
),
-- Direct sales of FR-T98Y-54
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(co.order_qty), 0) AS direct_qty
    FROM central_orders co
    JOIN target_product tp ON co.product_id = tp.product_id
),
-- Recursive BOM: find all products that contain FR-T98Y-54 at any level, with quantity per unit
-- Walk upward from FR-T98Y-54 to find all assemblies that contain it
bom_containment AS (
    -- Base: direct containment (FR-T98Y-54 is a component of some assembly)
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS qty_per_unit,
        bom.start_date,
        bom.end_date
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN target_product tp ON bom.component_id = tp.product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: assembly is a component of a higher-level assembly
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id,
        bc.qty_per_unit * bom.per_assembly_qty AS qty_per_unit,
        bom.start_date,
        bom.end_date
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN bom_containment bc ON bom.component_id = bc.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
),
-- Calculate contained demand: for each order, if the ordered product contains FR-T98Y-54
contained_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(co.order_qty * bc.qty_per_unit) AS contained_qty
    FROM central_orders co
    JOIN bom_containment bc ON co.product_id = bc.assembly_id
    WHERE co.order_date >= bc.start_date
      AND (bc.end_date IS NULL OR co.order_date <= bc.end_date)
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT direct_qty FROM direct_sales) + 
    (SELECT COALESCE(contained_qty, 0) FROM contained_demand) AS total_demand

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, find all orders from Canada territory in 2023
canada_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date, so.territory_id
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Canada'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
),
-- Get the product_id for FR-R92R-62
target_product AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'FR-R92R-62'
),
-- For each order line, find all BOM paths that lead to FR-R92R-62
-- We need to walk from each sold product down to components, checking if FR-R92R-62 appears
bom_expansion AS (
    -- Base case: direct sales of FR-R92R-62 itself (sold as a product)
    SELECT 
        sol.order_id,
        sol.line_id,
        sol.product_id AS assembly_id,
        sol.product_id AS component_id,
        sol.order_qty AS total_qty,
        0 AS bom_level
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN canada_orders co ON sol.order_id = co.order_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base case: first level components of sold products
    SELECT 
        sol.order_id,
        sol.line_id,
        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        sol.order_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        bom.bom_level
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN canada_orders co ON sol.order_id = co.order_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = sol.product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= co.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= co.order_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: deeper levels
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_id,
        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        be.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        bom.bom_level
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = be.component_id
    JOIN canada_orders co ON be.order_id = co.order_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND be.bom_level >= 0  -- ensure we can recurse
      AND bom.start_date <= co.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= co.order_date)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM bom_expansion be
JOIN target_product tp ON be.component_id = tp.product_id;

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, get all orders from UK territory in 2024 with their order lines
uk_orders_2024 AS (
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    WHERE st.name = 'United Kingdom'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
-- Recursive CTE to find all products that contain HB-T721 at any BOM level
-- Start from HB-T721 and walk up to all assemblies that contain it
hb_t721_containing_products AS (
    -- Base case: HB-T721 itself (sold directly)
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS per_unit_qty,  -- 1 unit of itself
        0 AS level
    FROM product p
    WHERE p.product_number = 'HB-T721'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: find assemblies that contain any product from the previous level
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id,
        CAST(bom.per_assembly_qty * cpp.per_unit_qty AS DOUBLE),
        cpp.level + 1
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN hb_t721_containing_products cpp ON bom.component_id = cpp.product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
),
-- For each order line, calculate the demand for HB-T721
-- This includes: direct sales of HB-T721 + HB-T721 contained in other products
demand_calculation AS (
    SELECT 
        uo.order_id,
        uo.order_date,
        uo.product_id,
        uo.order_qty,
        -- Check if this product is HB-T721 or contains it
        COALESCE(
            (SELECT per_unit_qty 
             FROM hb_t721_containing_products cpp 
             WHERE cpp.product_id = uo.product_id),
            0
        ) AS hb_t721_per_unit
    FROM uk_orders_2024 uo
)
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(order_qty * hb_t721_per_unit) AS DOUBLE) AS total_demand
FROM demand_calculation;

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, get all orders from Southwest territory in 2025
southwest_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Southwest'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
-- For each product sold, explode its BOM to find all components including itself
-- We need to find: direct sales of BB-9108, plus BB-9108 as component of other products
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: the product itself (treat as "component" of itself with qty 1)
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        so.product_id AS top_product_id,
        so.product_id AS component_id,
        so.order_qty AS total_qty,
        1.0 AS per_assembly_qty,
        CAST(so.order_qty AS DOUBLE) AS component_qty
    FROM southwest_orders so
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: expand components that are assemblies
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.top_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        be.total_qty,
        bom.per_assembly_qty,
        be.component_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS component_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = be.component_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= be.order_date)
),
-- Get the product_id for BB-9108
target_product AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'BB-9108'
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(be.component_qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM bom_explosion be
JOIN target_product tp ON be.component_id = tp.product_id;

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree(assembly_id, component_id, per_assembly_qty, depth) AS (
    -- Base case: direct components of the target product
    SELECT 
        b.assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty,
        1
    FROM product p
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'BK-R64Y-38'
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2021-03-03'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2021-03-03')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components of manufactured sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        b.assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        bt.per_assembly_qty * b.per_assembly_qty,
        bt.depth + 1
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = bt.component_id
    WHERE b.start_date <= DATE '2021-03-03'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2021-03-03')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product p WHERE p.product_id = bt.component_id AND p.make_flag = TRUE)
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(bt.per_assembly_qty * p.standard_cost), 2) AS purchased_parts_cost
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bt.component_id
WHERE p.make_flag = FALSE;
```

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Get product IDs
target_product AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'BK-M18S-44'
),
target_part AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'SH-4562'
),
-- Recursive CTE to find total quantity of SH-4562 per unit of BK-M18S-44 in current BOM
current_bom AS (

    WHERE b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components of sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        b.component_id,
        cb.total_qty * b.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty
    FROM current_bom cb
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = cb.component_id
    WHERE b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
),

    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components of sub-assemblies

    WHERE st.name = 'Canada'

      AND so.order_date < DATE '2023-01-01'
),

bom_edges AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.parent_code,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM canada_orders co
        WHERE c.valid_from <= co.order_date
          AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= co.order_date)
    )
),
-- Recursive BOM traversal: for each product, find all parts at any level
bom_tree AS (
    -- Base case: direct children
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.line_id,
        co.order_qty,
        p.product_number AS root_product,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM canada_orders co

    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = p.product_number
    WHERE c.valid_from <= co.order_date
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= co.order_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: go deeper into sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        bt.order_id,
        bt.line_id,
        bt.order_qty,
        bt.root_product,
        c.child_code,
        bt.total_qty * c.qty
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = bt.child_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= (
        SELECT co2.order_date FROM canada_orders co2 
        WHERE co2.order_id = bt.order_id AND co2.line_id = bt.line_id
    )
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= (
        SELECT co2.order_date FROM canada_orders co2 
        WHERE co2.order_id = bt.order_id AND co2.line_id = bt.line_id
      ))
      -- Only continue if current child is a manufactured product (make_flag = true)
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM product p2 WHERE p2.product_number = bt.child_code AND p2.make_flag = TRUE
      )
),

direct_sales AS (

        co.line_id,
        co.order_qty AS total_qty
    FROM canada_orders co
    JOIN product p ON co.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'CR-7833'
),
-- Get all component demands for CR-7833 from BOM expansion
component_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        bt.order_id,
        bt.line_id,
        bt.total_qty * bt.order_qty AS demand
    FROM bom_tree bt
    WHERE bt.child_code = 'CR-7833'
),

all_demand AS (
    SELECT total_qty AS demand FROM direct_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT demand FROM component_demand

        c.parent_code,
        bt.parent_code AS child_code,

    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN u_composition c

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_paths AS (
    -- Base case: all products that directly contain FR-R92R-62 in their BOM on each order date
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        sol.product_id AS sold_product_id,
        p.product_number AS sold_product_number,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty AS component_qty_per_unit
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = p.product_number
    WHERE c.child_code = 'FR-R92R-62'
      AND c.valid_from <= so.order_date
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= so.order_date)
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= DATE '2023-12-31'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: products that contain sub-assemblies which contain FR-R92R-62
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        sol.product_id AS sold_product_id,
        p.product_number AS sold_product_number,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty * bp.component_qty_per_unit AS component_qty_per_unit
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = p.product_number
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON bp.sold_product_id = (
        SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = c.child_code
    )
      AND bp.order_id = so.order_id
    WHERE c.valid_from <= so.order_date
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= so.order_date)
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= DATE '2023-12-31'
),
-- Get all orders from Canada territory in 2023
canada_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Canada'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= DATE '2023-12-31'
),
-- Calculate demand: direct sales of FR-R92R-62 plus component demand
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.order_id,
        sol.order_qty AS direct_qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'FR-R92R-62'
),
component_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        bp.order_id,
        SUM(sol.order_qty * bp.component_qty_per_unit) AS bom_qty
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON bp.order_id = sol.order_id 
        AND bp.sold_product_id = sol.product_id
    GROUP BY bp.order_id
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(ds.direct_qty), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(cd.bom_qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM canada_orders co
LEFT JOIN direct_sales ds ON co.order_id = ds.order_id
LEFT JOIN component_demand cd ON co.order_id = cd.order_id;
```
